capabilities.l1_description: Legal services within contract lifecycle management across all BCI business units, including drafting, review, and recommendations. Legal's contribution to enterprise-wide Contract Management (Procurement owns vendor contracts, asset classes own investment contracts, HR owns employment contracts)

l2_capabilities.l2_name: Investment Transaction Legal Guidance & Due Diligence
l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal due diligence, transaction structuring, and legal guidance for BCI's investment transactions, including fund investments, co-investments, and portfolio company transactions
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Core to investment mandate; due diligence directly protects beneficiaries. No current issues reported.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Deal management system fully integrated with due diligence workflows; automated document assembly and tracking; users highly satisfied with functionality.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Drafting, negotiating, reviewing, and managing legal agreements with regards to investment and fund management.
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Essential for fund relationships but some contract tracking gaps noted in recent audit.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: IMA tracking system covers core needs but renewal reminders require manual follow-up; some reporting gaps identified.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal guidance for fund formation / documentation, subscription agreements, and investment / fund structure optimization
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Regulatory requirement for fund formation; processes well-established and documented.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Fund documentation platform comprehensive with automated clause libraries and version control; enables best practices across all fund types.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal guidance on structuring and documentation for co-investment opportunities and joint venture arrangements with other investors or partners
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Supports deal flow but currently experiencing delays due to resource constraints and unclear workflows.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: JV documentation handled through generic tools not designed for complex deal structures; significant manual coordination required; evaluate specialized solution.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Ensuring compliance with securities regulations, investment restrictions, regulatory requirements specific to investment activities (e.g., prospectus requirements, securities filings, investment limits)
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Fiduciary obligation; some compliance monitoring gaps identified requiring attention.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Regulatory tracking adequate but mostly manual monitoring of compliance deadlines; good opportunity for workflow automation.

capabilities.l1_description: Management of corporate governance, board operations, policy administration, and corporate records management.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal review of contracts initiated by business units (procurement, HR, IT), including risk assessment, legal terms negotiation, and approval workflows
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Standard business enabler; current processes functioning well with no complaints.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Contract review AI tool excellent fit for standard agreements; minimal manual effort needed for routine reviews.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Drafting BCI led contracts (NDAs, settlement agreements, legal service agreements) and maintaining contract templates, clause libraries, and contract standards
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Efficiency-focused capability; template library outdated and needs refresh.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Template library functional but manual version control; high volume creates opportunity for automation with clause management system.

capabilities.l1_description: Management of BCI's relationships with government entities, regulatory stakeholders, and freedom of information requests

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Management of litigation matters including court proceedings, discovery, legal strategy, outside counsel coordination, legal holds, settlements, and court filings
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Important for risk mitigation but active matters showing coordination challenges with outside counsel.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: E-billing system partial fit for litigation tracking; matter management gaps require parallel spreadsheet tracking; assess fit before further investment.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Intake, tracking, assignment, collaboration, and closure of non-litigation legal matters across all practice areas (investment, advisory, compliance, transactional), including matter workflow management and resource allocation
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Operational necessity; intake process streamlined and stakeholders satisfied.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Matter intake system highly automated with self-service portal; excellent integration with case management; stakeholders satisfied.

capabilities.l1_description: Legal services supporting BCI's investment activities, including fund investments, investment manager relationships, and securities compliance specific to investment operations

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Monitoring regulatory changes, horizon scanning, regulatory interpretation, impact analysis, and maintaining regulatory content repository to keep Legal and business informed of regulatory developments
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Critical for staying ahead of regulatory changes; monitoring tools need enhancement.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Regulatory intelligence relies on manual monitoring and email alerts; adequate coverage but automation would improve timeliness.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Development and management of compliance programs, compliance assessments, compliance monitoring and testing, regulatory reporting and filings, and compliance advisory to business units
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Regulatory requirement; program framework solid with clean audit results.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Compliance program fully supported by GRC platform; automated policy attestation and training tracking; clean audit results.

l2_capabilities.l2_name: Personal, Private, and Sensitive Information Protection Legal Advisory
l2_capabilities.l2_description: Privacy compliance (e.g. PIPEDA, GDPR), privacy impact assessments, privacy policy development, personal, private, and sensitive information protection advisory, privacy breach response and notification, and consent management
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Privacy compliance mandatory; recent PIPEDA assessment revealed gaps requiring remediation.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Privacy tools inadequate for current regulatory requirements; manual tracking of data subject requests; replacement recommended.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Personal trading preclearance, trade monitoring, material non-public information (MNPI) management, and restricted list management
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Supports trading compliance; preclearance system functional but manual workarounds needed.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: MNPI controls partially automated through information barriers system; some manual attestation processes; targeted improvements needed.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Code of Conduct administration, ethics programs, misconduct case management (intake, investigation, resolution), whistleblower hotline management, and ethics training.
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Foundational to culture; ethics program well-received with high completion rates.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Ethics platform comprehensive with automated disclosures, gift tracking, and annual certifications; highly effective.

capabilities.l1_description: Legal advisory, research, and education services provided to BCI business units, supporting business decision-making, risk assessment, and legal awareness

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal research using legal databases (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Practical Law), precedent analysis, statutory interpretation, case law research, and legal intelligence gathering
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Enables informed decisions; research tools adequate but response times could improve.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Legal research databases adequate but search functionality limited; AI-assisted research tools could improve efficiency.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Providing legal opinions, and guidance to business stakeholders on legal questions, typically delivered through memos or emails
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Key advisory function but backlog growing and some stakeholder dissatisfaction noted.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Opinion drafting heavily manual with limited template support; system doesn't meet complex advisory needs; evaluate fit before automation.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal guidance for BCI corporate transactions (M&A involving BCI itself, corporate partnerships, strategic alliances) and due diligence. Note: Distinct from Investment Transaction guidance (which covers BCI's investment activities)
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Supports M&A activity; current capacity sufficient for transaction volume.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: M&A due diligence tools excellent fit; virtual data room fully integrated; manual approach appropriate for high-judgment work.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal risk identification, assessment, and advisory to support business decision-making, including legal risk scoring, risk mitigation recommendations, and decision support
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Valuable for decision support; methodology needs standardization across practice areas.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Risk assessment partially automated; framework adequate but scoring mechanisms need refinement.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Training and educating business stakeholders on legal topics, compliance requirements, policy changes, legal developments, and legal literacy to enable proactive risk management. Note: This is Legal training THE BUSINESS (distinct from Legal Talent Development which trains Legal staff)
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Nice-to-have capability; training well-received when delivered but not consistently scheduled.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Training delivery through LMS works well for compliance modules; manual effort appropriate for interactive legal workshops.

capabilities.l1_description: Operational capabilities that enable Legal Affairs to function effectively, including external counsel management, budget, technology, knowledge, performance, and project management

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Managing corporate governance framework, governance policies, corporate governance best practices, and governance advisory to ensure BCI meets governance standards and obligations
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Board-critical capability; governance framework struggling with recent regulatory changes.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Board portal highly automated but poor integration with document management; workflow conflicts causing user frustration; prioritize fix.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Managing board and committee meetings, preparing board materials, maintaining board minutes and resolutions, managing board approvals, and coordinating board-related legal activities
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Supports board effectiveness; some delays in materials preparation noted.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Committee support partially automated; calendar and materials distribution adequate; agenda management needs improvement.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Development, maintenance, review, and retirement of corporate policies and directives, including policy approval workflows, policy communication, and policy repository management
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Operational enabler; policy repository organized and accessible.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Policy management system excellent fit with automated review cycles; opportunity to add workflow automation for approvals.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Management of BCI's records management definitions and practices, including record classifications and retention schedules, and archiving to ensure compliance with records retention regulations and obligations.
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Administrative function; retention schedules need review and updates.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Records management mostly manual with file shares; adequate for current needs but automation would improve retrieval efficiency.

capabilities.l1_description: Enterprise-wide regulatory compliance and ethics program management, including regulatory intelligence, privacy compliance, trading controls, and ethics programs. Legal owns this at BCI.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Selection, engagement, management, and oversight of external law firms and legal service providers (e.g. legal research vendors, legal technology vendors), including outside counsel guidelines and e-billing
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Cost management important; vendor relationships strained due to billing disputes.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Outside counsel management system partial fit; rate tracking works but matter assignment process has gaps; assess before automating.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal Affairs department budgeting, forecasting, spend tracking, variance analysis, invoice processing, and financial reporting to manage Legal Affairs' financial resources effectively. Note: Enterprise budgeting owned by Finance; this is Legal's departmental budget
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Internal function; budget tracking adequate for current needs.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Legal spend tracking excellent fit in finance system; mostly manual but low volume doesn't justify automation investment.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Management of Legal Affairs' technology stack (e.g. matter management, law firm e-billing, document management, research databases), vendor relationships, technology implementation, user adoption, system optimization, first line technical support and technology strategy.
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Efficiency driver; technology stack fragmented with user adoption challenges.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Legal tech stack adequate but manual integration between systems; good automation opportunity for data synchronization.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Management of Legal's knowledge assets including knowledge repository, precedent libraries, playbooks, templates, best practices, and expertise directories to capture and share legal knowledge
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Knowledge sharing valuable; repository exists but utilization is low.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Knowledge management excellent fit with search and taxonomy; opportunity to automate content tagging and curation.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Legal operations analytics, dashboards, KPIs, metrics, performance reporting, and business intelligence to measure Legal Affairs' effectiveness, efficiency, and value delivery
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Performance visibility needed; metrics not consistently tracked or reported.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Performance metrics tracked manually in spreadsheets; current tools don't meet reporting needs; consider replacement.

l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Compliance requirement; entity records current but process is manual.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Entity management partially automated; corporate records adequate but subsidiary tracking needs improvement.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Professional development of Legal Affairs staff including continuing legal education (CLE), skills development, training programs, career development, and succession planning for Legal Affairs team members. Note: This develops Legal staff (distinct from Stakeholder Legal Education which trains business)
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Staff development important; CLE tracking in place and functioning well.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Training tracking manual but LMS platform excellent fit; low volume makes manual approach cost-effective.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Manage legal-related projects, ensuring compliance, timely delivery, and alignment with organizational objectives through structured planning, resource management, and risk oversight.
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Project delivery support; no formal methodology causing inconsistent outcomes.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Project tracking adequate through generic PM tool; some legal-specific workflow gaps; targeted improvements recommended.

capabilities.l1_description: Management of legal matters, cases, and legal work across Legal Affairs, including litigation, disputes, and general legal matters, tracked through matter management systems

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Development and execution of government relations strategies, engagement with government entities and regulatory stakeholders, advocacy, issues management, and managing BCI's government affairs activities
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Strategically important; government relationships strong but recent regulatory changes creating challenges.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: Stakeholder database highly automated but poor fit for government relations tracking; contact management inadequate; fix urgently.

l2_capabilities.l2_description: Complete FOI request lifecycle management including FOI intake, assessment, response coordination, disclosure review, FOI tracking, deadline management, and FOI compliance to meet access to information obligations
l2_capabilities.bh_notes: Compliance obligation; FOI response process efficient with good deadline management.
l2_capabilities.btf_notes: FOI request system excellent fit with automated workflows; opportunity to further automate response assembly.
